text_block_list.text:
That's all from Aston Machan. Everyone, be 
sure to remember me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"This is interview practice. A swarm of 
reporters will surely come rushing in 
after the race, after all."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From the moment the gates open, to 
crossing the finish line, to giving 
post-race interviews...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With how well things are going right now, 
thinking that far ahead isn't getting 
ahead of ourselves—or so I feel, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it, yes.
